meta.name: MemeTracker
meta.shortDescription: Track Dogecoin payments to an address (mempool + tip blocks)
meta.longDescription: MemeTracker watches Dogecoin P2P for payments to tracked P2PKH addresses. It observes relayed mempool transactions (inv/getdata for tx) and adds a tip-focused header/block safeguard (~24h of headers, block getdata) so watched payments that miss the mempool path are still caught. The web UI includes a dashboard (charts, P2P/mempool/header-safeguard stats), address tracking, transaction list, peers view, optional API IP allowlist / access token, and Start/Stop for the P2P watcher. Built from https://github.com/qlpqlp/memetracker. DogeBOX env seeds memetracker_config.json on first boot so P2P can auto-start. Parallel P2P sessions (default 3), DNS seeds and shuffled peer IPs improve gossip; for maximum reliability set P2P_HOST to your own Dogecoin Core. Addresses expire after retention days without /track refresh.
